name: Gimpo International Airport

runway.v: two runways; the longest, 14L/32R, is 3,600 m long and 45 m wide

customs.v: customs and immigration as required by operations (HO)

curfew.v: no take-offs or landings from 23:00 to 06:00 local time (1400-2100 UTC) for noise
curfew.quote: Take-off and landing is restricted from 1400 UTC to 2100 UTC due to noise abatement

hours.v: aerodrome open 06:00 to 23:00 local time (2100-1400 UTC); ATS 24 hours

ppr.v: general aviation must contact the airport operator's airside operations team at least 1 day before the flight to confirm a stand
ppr.quote: should contact with airport operator (airside operations team) at least 1 day before the flight

max_aircraft.v: international private flights excluded if the aircraft seats more than 50 passengers or has a maximum payload of 2,721 kg or more
max_aircraft.quote: Aircraft having a seating capacity of more than 50 passengers

handling.v: 4 business aircraft hangars for code C aircraft (no handling agents named)
handling.quote: Business aircraft hangar : 4 for code letter "C" aircraft

noise.v: no engine run-ups or idle power checks from 23:00 to 06:00 local time
noise.quote: Run up checks and idle power check are not allowed from 1400 UTC to 2100 UTC.

missing: iata (AIP page does not state it)

notes: Times converted from UTC to Korea time (UTC+9, no daylight saving). Excluded from international use at Gimpo: non-scheduled public charter, inclusive tour charter, >50 seats, max payload 2,721 kg (6,000 lb) or more, aircraft carrying commercial goods. A paid charter therefore needs checking case by case; a company- or person-owned private flight is the permitted case. Newest RKSS page found was the 19 Feb 2025 package (no effective date printed on the page); a newer Korean package (8 Jan 2026) exists for RKSI, so the RKSS page may be superseded.
